Usage: claude [options] [command] [prompt]

Options:
  --dangerously-skip-permissions        Bypass all permission checks.
  --json-schema <schema>                JSON Schema for structured output validation.
  --no-session-persistence              Disable session persistence (only works with --print)
  --output-format <format>              "text", "json", or "stream-json"
  --permission-mode <mode>              choices: acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, manual, dontAsk, plan
  -p, --print                           Print response and exit
  --strict-mcp-config                   Ignore all other MCP configurations
